item.text: £7 and £10 merit priority in the next behavioural test. £7 has higher stated interest, but their gross proxies are not statistically separated; the contribution point leader also changes with the assumed cost. Missing intent rises with price, and counting all missing intent as zero makes the £7 and £10 base-cost proxies almost identical.
